topography.project_purpose: Liquidity Manager. Structurally: 156 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 19 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 3 Chainlink feeds; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 38 common project-authored base contract(s) (rewardsdistributionrecipient, owned, synth). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
